week.desc: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
features: - Primary monitor only: the taskbar widget sits on the primary monitor's taskbar.
- Crowded taskbars: with a very full centered Windows 11 taskbar, the app buttons can reach the widget. On Windows 10 the task-button area is narrowed automatically.
- Sleeping devices: a device that is asleep may not answer. Its last value stays visible, dimmed. Logitech receivers drop sleeping devices from the link, so their last value is kept for 30 minutes.
- Keychron keyboards: they only report their battery over Bluetooth (shown via the Bluetooth support). Over the 2.4 GHz receiver the firmware does not expose it. Keychron mice are supported.
- Other devices: some 2.4 GHz devices use undocumented protocols and are not supported yet. See CONTRIBUTING.md for how to help add one.
week.trDesc: 在 Windows 10/11 任务栏上显示无线鼠标、耳机（含麦克风）、键盘和控制器的电量。轻量级托盘应用程序，无需供应商软件。支持罗技、雷蛇、赛睿、海盗船、HyperX、Glorious、PS4/PS5 DualSense、Xbox 和蓝牙设备。
week.trFeat:
- 仅主显示器：任务栏小部件位于主显示器的任务栏上。
- 拥挤的任务栏：如果 Windows 11 的居中任务栏非常拥挤，应用程序按钮可能会碰到小工具。在Windows 10上，任务按钮区域会自动缩小。
- 休眠设备：处于休眠状态的设备可能不会响应。其最后一个值仍会显示，但呈灰显状态。 罗技接收器会将处于休眠状态的设备从连接中移除，因此它们的最后一个值会保留 30 分钟。
- Keychron 键盘：它们仅通过蓝牙报告电量（通过蓝牙支持显示）。通过 2.4 GHz 接收器时，固件不会显示电量。支持 Keychron 鼠标。
- 其他设备：一些 2.4 GHz 设备使用未公开的协议，目前尚不支持。请参阅 CONTRIBUTING。 md ，了解如何帮助添加一个。

week.desc: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
features: - Packages (package.json) and source files; skips nodemodules, build output, fixtures,
- Units: a folder of source files, or a file at a package's source root.
- Waves: a unit's imports come in earlier waves; import cycles are ported together.
- Bridge: napi-rs when the unit or anything it imports needs Node; wasm-bindgen for portable
- Readiness (how safe) and priority (safe and worth it: loops and string work, tests, size).
week.trDesc: 使用 Rust 逐一重写您的整个应用程序，并在每一步对照原始应用程序的记录行为进行检查。TypeScript、Python、C、Go、Ruby 和 Java 中的 CLI、HTTP 服务器和库。
week.trFeat:
- 包（package.json）和源文件；跳过 nodemodules、构建输出、夹具、
- 单元：源文件文件夹，或位于包的源根目录下的文件。
- 波次：一个单元的导入项在较早的波次中出现；导入循环一起移植。
- 桥接：当单元或其导入的任何内容需要 Node 时使用 napi-rs；使用 wasm-bindgen 实现可移植性 - 准备情况（安全性如何）和优先级（安全且值得：环和绳索工作、测试、尺寸）。

week.desc: Yab, yet another browser: a fast native macOS browser with an iPhone and Android companion
features: - One field. Type an address and you go there; type words and you search. It finishes addresses from your own history and sends nothing until you press Return.
- Tabs that stay out of the way. Pins, folders and spaces. Tabs from your last session come back instantly and cost nothing until you click them. ⌘K finds any open tab.
- Two engines. WebKit by default; Chromium on Apple silicon for the sites that need it, with Chrome extensions, Chrome DevTools and the Chrome Web Store.
- Blocking and hiding built in. An ad blocker that runs inside the engine, before a request is made. ⇧⌘H hides any element on a site, for good.
- Reading mode, floating video, split view, Peek, each one key away.
- Passwords in your keychain, or in the password manager you already use.
- Agents in their own tabs, with your sign-ins, asking before they send, pay or delete.
- Sync that can't be read: optional, end to end encrypted, between your Macs and iPhone.
week.trDesc: Yab，又一款浏览器：一款快速的原生macOS浏览器，并有iPhone和Android配套版本
week.trFeat:

- 两种引擎。默认使用 WebKit； 基于 Apple 芯片的 Chromium，适用于需要它的网站，并提供 Chrome 扩展、Chrome DevTools 和 Chrome 网上应用店。
- 内置拦截和隐藏功能。一款在发出请求之前在引擎内部运行的广告拦截器。⇧⌘H 可永久隐藏网站上的任何元素。
- 阅读模式、悬浮视频、分屏视图、Peek，一键即可使用。
- 密码存储在您的钥匙串中，或您已在使用的密码管理器中。 - 代理位于各自的标签页中，使用您的登录信息，在发送、支付或删除之前征求您的同意。

week.desc: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
features: - Fully asynchronous RL on veRL
- GRPO, dynamic sampling, and Score Centering
- FSDP and sequence parallelism for long-context training
- Memory-efficient training with gradient checkpointing and activation offloading
- Prefix caching across rounds, with LMCache offloading the KV cache to CPU
- Optimized kernels for H100, H200 and GB300
- Simulators on the same Ray cluster: MuJoCo on CPUs, Isaac Sim on GPUs
- Robotic benchmarks: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, RoboDojo and RoboLab-120
- General benchmarks: nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks through EvalScope
- A model server: vLLM server on one RTX 5090 or GB300, with decode megakernels
- A robot station: the agent loop that drives a YAM or an SO-101 robot
week.trDesc: 在模拟中训练推理模型，以便原生使用真实机器人
week.trFeat:
- veRL 上的全异步强化学习
- GRPO、动态采样和分数中心化
- 用于长上下文训练的FSDP和序列并行
- 通过梯度检查点和激活卸载实现内存高效训练
- 跨轮次的前缀缓存，LMCache 将 KV 缓存卸载到 CPU
- 针对H100、H200和GB300优化的内核
- 同一Ray集群上的模拟器：CPU上的MuJoCo，GPU上的Isaac Sim - 机器人基准：LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、RoboDojo 和 RoboLab-120
- 一般基准：通过 EvalScope 进行的九项推理、编码和视觉基准测试
- 模型服务器：一台 RTX 5090 或 GB300 上的 vLLM 服务器，带有解码巨型内核
- 机器人工作站：驱动 YAM 或 SO-101 机器人的代理循环
